context: Whole group hosts a small picnic; reflecting on the year past.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 皆、ようけピクニックに来てくれた!
lines.en: Everyone came out for the picnic!
lines.style: Warm, expansive opening—a man genuinely delighted to see his people gathered. Loose, generous in the tone. Full chest, not contained.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 気楽に、過ごせて、楽しい時間。
lines.en: We can just be ourselves, and that makes it so much fun.
lines.style: Soft, almost contemplative warmth. Speaking more to herself than the room. Tender gratitude underneath, no performance. Breath settles at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お弁当、夢中になって食べた!
lines.en: I got so caught up eating my bento!
lines.style: Quick, unguarded delight. The laugh is already in his voice before he finishes speaking. Small boy's genuine surprise at his own appetite.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 皆と、こんな日、毎月したい!
lines.en: I want days like this to happen every month!
lines.style: Bright, urgent wish—not demanding, but earnest. A little leap upward at 'every month'. Open-voiced, unselfconscious. The whole room should hear this hope.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 感謝の気持ち、ようけあります。
lines.en: I'm so grateful for all of you.
lines.style: Quiet, steady gratitude. No tremor, no performance—just a woman saying something true. Deliberate pace. The kind of thanks that doesn't need embellishment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: This—this is what connecting really looks like!
lines.style: Loud, unrestrained joy. First word lands hard. Kansai directness—no filter between feeling and voice. A laugh behind it. She's claiming this moment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 愛情、ようけ感じる、本当に。
lines.en: I feel so much love right now, honestly.
lines.style: Warm, exposed admission. A man letting himself say something soft in front of everyone. No apology in the delivery. Steady breath, steady voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 家族で、こうやって、過ごせるの、宝物。
lines.en: Being able to spend time together like this as a family—that's the real treasure.
lines.style: Slow, reverent cadence. Each phrase lands separately, like she's holding them up to the light. Voice softens on 'treasure'. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Unfiltered six-year-old certainty. Clean and bright, no hedging. The words come out like they've been sitting in his chest waiting.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: こういう日、ずっと、続けてほしい。
lines.en: I hope days like this never stop.
lines.style: Quiet, steady wish—not demanding, but deeply felt. A girl looking at what matters. Slight trailing-off, like she's checking whether it's okay to want this.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おばあちゃんも、嬉しい!
lines.style: Surprise and warmth together. A woman noticing someone she loves is moved. Voice steady but eyes bright. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: これからも、皆で、繋がろう!
lines.en: Let's stay connected like this, all of us, going forward.
lines.style: Loud, clear commitment. Kansai directness without apology. A declaration more than a suggestion. Breath full, voice grounded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Bright, celebratory lift. A man raising his voice and his glass together. Quick, clean. The kind of cheerful that invites everyone to join.
